title: Venus Williams Gets a US Open Wildcard — Could Serena Join Her?
summary:
Guess what? Venus Williams is back at the US Open! She's 46 years old and has been playing tennis for a super long time. She got a wildcard, which is like a special invitation to play in the big tournament in New York. It starts on August 30.

Venus first played there 29 years ago, when she was just a teenager! She even reached the final in 1997. She won the US Open two times, in 2000 and 2001. That's amazing!

But here's the cool part: her sister Serena might join her! Serena is 44 and came back to tennis in June after taking a break for four years. She hurt her knee at Wimbledon, but she and Venus played doubles together in Cincinnati on Tuesday. They lost a really close match, but the crowd loved them!

There's still one wildcard spot left for the singles. Could Serena get it? We'll have to wait and see!

Venus hasn't won a singles match in a while. She's lost her last 10 matches this year. But she's still a superstar, and fans pack the stands to see her and Serena play.

Serena has won 23 Grand Slam titles, which is more than almost anyone ever! She played what everyone thought was her last tournament in 2022, but she came back. Now she's playing again, and it's super exciting.

So keep an eye on the US Open. Will the Williams sisters both be there? It would be awesome to see them play again!
why_it_matters: It shows that age does not have to stop people from doing what they love, and you can cheer for athletes who keep trying even after losses.

background_read: The US Open is one of the four Grand Slam tennis tournaments, and it is held in New York every year.
Venus Williams (a famous American tennis champion) and Serena Williams (Venus's younger sister and also a tennis superstar) have been some of the biggest names in tennis for many years.
Grand Slam tournaments are the biggest events in tennis, and Wimbledon is the famous English tournament where Serena hurt her knee.
Article_Structure: WHO: Venus Williams and her sister Serena Williams, two famous tennis champions.
WHAT: Venus received a wildcard to play in the US Open; Serena might receive one too, but nothing is certain yet.
WHERE: The US Open in New York; Venus and Serena also played doubles together in Cincinnati.
WHY: Fans love the Williams sisters, and people want to see if both sisters will play in the same tournament again.

Some people wonder how well Venus will do because she has lost her last 10 singles matches this year.
